notes.subject: זקן בא בימים ×2
notes.rationale: Hebrew repeats the phrase 'old, advanced in days' exactly — YHWH echoes the narrator word for word; the echo is kept but the idiom 'come into days' rendered as 'go het long ol de'.

notes.subject: בא בימים
notes.rationale: Literally 'come into days'; rendered 'go het long ol de' (advanced in days).

notes.subject: to Yehoshua
notes.rationale: Yahwe directly addresses Joshua about his old age and the remaining land.

notes.subject: land remaining
notes.rationale: Verse opens an inventory of unconquered territory that runs to v.7 — a territorial census.

translation: Na Yehoshua i olpela pinis, i go het long ol de; na Yahwe i tokim em: Yu olpela pinis, yu go het long ol de, na graun i stap yet planti tumas bilong rausim ⟨em⟩ ol arapela na kisim.

tokens.gloss: bilong rausim ⟨em⟩ ol arapela na kisim
